root_cause: The first evidence-first portal platform summary relied on status and evidence_available from the last generated database snapshot. A cached PASS could remain visually green after expires_at even when the snapshot had not refreshed.

prevention.rule: Green requires observed_at <= now < expires_at for every required provider observation AND an independently fresh (<24h) snapshot generatedAt. Invalid, missing, future or expired values are EVIDENCE_PARTIAL; explicit failures remain ACTION_REQUIRED.
prevention.boundary: Rendering safeguard only; do not change backend authorization, service tokens, raw private evidence or release writer.
prevention.closure: After protected merge verify exact Netlify production SHA, authenticated tenant-scoped Portal and an old snapshot rendering non-green. No production/no-recurrence claims without independent readback.

evidence.source: original security-trust-workspace.js platform summary code review, original Brain failure register
